answer: In an agent economy, each new identity must post a substantial bond of locked tokens that increases based on cluster analysis of funding graphs and registration timing. An atlas of interconnected wallets exposes sybil clusters, while pure ivory-tower reputation alone is insufficient without capital cost. A sudden comet of mass registrations automatically raises the required bond, forcing attackers to immobilize large sums at risk of slashing, making coordinated multi-account attacks prohibitively expensive relative to rewards.
